$comment: Time-bounded exceptions for high/critical dependency findings in apps/web (AGENTS.md, ADR-0440). An exception must name an owner, expire within 180 days, and cover only code that is not in the shipped browser bundle. scripts/verify_web_audit_contract.mjs enforces this and fails on stale entries. An entry counts only when approvedBy names the accountable owner; until then it is a proposal and the gate fails (use --allow-pending to report it as a warning).

exceptions.reason: Buffer-overflow advisory in toBigIntLE with no patched release. Reachable only through @solana/spl-token, a devDependency used by localnet tests and fixtures; it is not imported by the browser bundle (verified absent from dist) and processes only synthetic test data. Mitigation: do not use spl-token helpers on untrusted input; revisit when a patched release or a maintained alternative exists.
